Shared notes you can organise like your own.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Organise shared notes.** Tag and pin notes shared with you — for you only. Editors can reshare, and the note's colour is shared by everyone.
- **Share linked notes together.** Sharing a note offers the notes it links to, and links keep working for the people you share with.

### ✨ Improvements
- Embeds preview as a whole, the drag grip is quieter, and only one cursor shows while editing (luthor 2.11.11).

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- Includes a database migration; it runs on start.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.4.3...v0.4.4](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.4.3...v0.4.4)
